intelligence.human_view: Think of a house where every room already has good furniture — and someone keeps buying new furniture instead of using what is there. Shawn stops that. The news does not need a new feed; it needs the blocks we already have, one story in one block. The news hub does not need a new page; it is the Hub, with three words changed on the pills. The words on the blocks do not need fancy names; a headline is a headline, a story is a story, and "hook" is a trick word that goes. The boards do not need to repeat white and purple; each one takes its own colour from the sequence, so scrolling down the page walks through the system's colours in order. The comment area does not need a heading on top; the first thing you meet is the place to write. The month's name gets the special font, because a name is special — but the number stays a number, in dashboard tiles, green around the edge. And the sidebar does not need a new design; the beautiful one comes back, and the citizen picks which bar they want — as long as the one they pick actually opens and closes.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your blocks are already so good! You do not need new blocks! You use the ones you have! One story goes in one block! The top line is called Headline! The part under it is called Story! Not hook! Hook is a silly word, so it goes! Each board lights up in its own color! Red, green, blue, all in a row! Like a rainbow walk! And the first thing you see is where to write! Easy!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — we use the good blocks we already have, dear, no need for new ones! One story in one block, love, with a headline on top and the story right under it — and we don't call it a hook anymore, dear, because a hook sounds like a trick, and our stories are not tricks! Each board lights up around the edges in its own lovely colour, love, one after another like a rainbow as you scroll down! And when you want to write, dear, the writing box is right there at the top, waiting for you!
intelligence.naya_view: Answer every question about NayaNET in a smart note each, auto-organized into its category, visible in the feed — right away. Block language: "Headline" first, story directly under it in the same block, never "in a nutshell" or "feature story" as the headline label; "hook" gone everywhere, swapped to "story", search the whole tree. People door reads "Connections", never "Your People", everywhere. News renders as intelligent blocks in the Hub feed — one post per story, smart note per topic, links as buttons — no separate news worker, no separate feed, three-cron direction stood down, never claim it runs itself until the crons exist. News hub is the Hub with LOCAL / PROVINCIAL / GLOBAL pills; each pill filters the middle feed to its scope. Boards light around the edge in the full spectrum, sidebar sequence, scrolling; never white/purple alternating; Dashboard purple, Business green. Comment area: entry first at top, chips smaller below, prompt as an elevated statement block at the bottom, no heading; COMMENT dead center green, SHARE INTEL in the corner; answer the "Welcome" pill. Date header: only "November" in the certificate font; 19 in dashboard digit tiles with the green edge; time in its own button centered under the month; "Thursday the 19th" to the left. Sidebar restored as before, colour-aligned with the left; citizen chooses IM bar, DM bar, sidebar or neither; every option opens and closes reliably; Messenger never opens empty.
